description: MIT TypeScript engine for multiplayer browser games: one ECS and Rapier simulation shared by the browser and an authoritative room server, a three.js WebGPU/WebGL2 renderer, ten finished multiplayer genre templates, and a typed declarative game API with an MCP server for coding agents.
rules: A Net Forge game is one file, src/game.ts, of declarations imported only from @netforge/engine.
Start a game from a template with npm create netforge@latest or the MCP tool netforge_create_game.
Never write renderers, netcode or physics in game code; the template provides them.
Models and sounds are asset library ids such as style.lowpoly.ghost, never URLs or file paths.
Ids are lower_snake_case, and every game declares at least one earn.rule and one earn.stake.
Validate with netforge_validate_game and playtest with netforge_run_playtest (engine.test.run) after each change.
Run a game locally with kit play (npm run play): play money, no wallet or chain.
